neighbours.label: 'away' or 'leave' marking someone being absent or leaving home or work ('when you're away', 'before you leave')
fire: Set the timer so the lamp comes on while you are away.
Feed the cat before you leave for the airport.
His wife is often away on business trips in spring.
Lock the windows each time you leave the house.
The plants stay watered even when the owners are away.
Pack a lunch before you leave for work each morning.
When the kids are away at camp, the house goes quiet.
She stayed away from the office for a full week.
quiet: Set the timer so the lamp comes on at six o'clock.
Feed the cat before you wash the dishes.
His wife is often busy with school plays in spring.
Lock the windows each time you clean the house.
The plants stay watered even when it does not rain.
Pack a lunch before you get ready each morning.
When the kids are at home, the house gets loud.
She stayed late at the office for a full week.
